title: A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Decode circular position relative to reward from CA1 activity, retaining Fig. 3 before-switch and after-switch conditions and RR, TR and non-RR cell panels; Fig. 2 remapping outputs remain calibration.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Decode circular position relative to reward from CA1 activity, retaining Fig. 3 before-switch and after-switch conditions and RR, TR and non-RR cell panels; Fig. 2 remapping outputs remain calibration.

Source-paper comparison for Fig. 3b session-level mean cosine RR decoding score, retaining every source condition: Per-sample score cos(theta_RR - theta_hat_RR), higher is better; Fig. 3b compares session means with shuffle means. Effect size 2.7 for post-switch RR is not a cosine score.
success_criteria: Recover the exact Fig. 3 source scores and source-authorized rerun, including original 11 mice and seven switch days.
Match original targets, retrospective cell memberships, occupancy samples, folds, inputs and preprocessing privileges for candidate and author comparator.
Beat the published result and the verified author rerun on the same admitted endpoint with a task-specific meaningful-effect and uncertainty rule.
Report every original condition; no larger standardized effect against shuffle, chronological split score, or reduced cohort is a paper win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
